input.quote: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
input.rationale: Section 13 (p0078) is the only renewal provision: a 1-year initial term with automatic successive one-year (12-month) renewal terms, and either party (including Client) may prevent renewal on written notice given 30 days before the end of the then-current year. The renewal term length (12 months) and the non-renewal notice window (30 days) satisfy the fallback element on notice window (no more than 60 days) and in fact match the preferred parameters for renewal length and Customer opt-out; there is no automatic multi-year renewal and no notice window approaching 90 days, so no walk-away risk. On price, renewal confers no unilateral uplift right on TrueLink: fees are fixed by the Exhibit A/B schedule, Section 6 (p0047) holds Hosting Services costs flat for the first year and caps rates at TrueLink's best-customer rate, and Section 16 (p0081) requires any amendment to be in writing and signed, so an increase cannot be imposed at renewal. The conditional price-cap element is therefore not triggered. The only gaps are preferred-level trimmings — no Vendor reminder 60 days before renewal and no express CPI/3% cap on any negotiated uplift — which we note rather than redline.
